The scores from the two paths suggest a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, with Oxostephamiersine being a potential modulator of Mcl-1 activity. The evidence highlights a network of targets that could be involved in the regulation of Mcl-1, but further experimental validation is needed to confirm the direct interaction.
